question_bn: City B is 5 miles east of city A. City C is 10 miles southeast of city B. Which of the following is the closest to the distance from city A to City C?
solution_steps: A 10-mile southeast move has east and south components 10/sqrt(2).
AC is about sqrt((5+10/sqrt(2))^2 + (10/sqrt(2))^2) = 13.99 miles, closest to 14.
